description: What this release sends for the same local Create payload (federation.WireMembers), and what a v0.11.1 receiver needs from it. Since #1604 a top-level comment carries no inReplyTo on the wire (the local record's inReplyTo naming the post stays local); the envelope object is the commented target (target_uri, federation.WireObject). A v0.11.1 receiver reads content and treats a missing inReplyTo as a top-level comment.
